name: capacitor-mcp
description: Connect AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Codex) to Capacitor and Ionic tooling over Model Context Protocol. Covers the awesome-ionic-mcp server (Ionic component APIs, Capacitor plugin docs, Ionic/Capacitor CLI tools), the Capgo hosted MCP at https://api.capgo.app/mcp, the local Capgo CLI MCP (npx @capgo/cli@latest mcp), and Xcode's MCP bridge (xcrun mcpbridge) for building the iOS app from an agent. Use when the user wants to add, configure, verify, or troubleshoot
author: Cap-go
